scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements. Each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q1 and e1, o2 has q2, q3 and e4, and o3 has q4 and e5. The o3 evidence is thin, though. o3 is a create objective, and both of its items are apply-level multiple choice set in the same 家計簿アプリの予算 scenario. Both turn on one element of the prompt (「SPEC.mdに書いて」), so e5 adds little over q4.

hook-problem is a concrete 2-sentence scenario with no trivia: 「ほしかったのは、スマートフォンでボタンがはみ出すのを直すことだけでした」. s1-example and s3-steps later solve exactly this problem. q0 is an ungraded predict item, and its distractors are the brief's misconceptions: stronger adjectives, Manualモード, and `/rewind` with the same prompt.

The prerequisites name 第1回 and 第2回. s2-defs (「第2回で見た権限モードの1つです」) and s2-version (「第2回のおさらい」) recall them. 4つの観点, @参照, 4つのフェーズ, 差分, 仕様 and AskUserQuestionツール are defined before use and match the glossary. package.json in q3 (s3-check) is never glossed in a beginner lesson, although the item can be answered without knowing it.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 2295 (budget 1,200–2,400) … est 19.1 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. The body is just under the budget ceiling. s2 is dense: 7 non-quiz blocks covering the four phases, three ways to enter plan mode and when to skip planning. s4-interview adds three glossed jargon terms (UI/UX, エッジケース, トレードオフ) on top of the two terms in s4-defs.

s3-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal titles and a reason for most steps, and it comes before both practice sections. Examples: ex-explore 「知った現状が、計画を読む物差しになります」, ex-plan 「書く前に、進め方を読める形にするためです」, ex-commit 「記録すれば、あとで戻せます」. For o1 and o2 the lesson goes straight from the full example to independent practice, with no faded example in between.

Every content section ends with an inline quiz. q1, q2 and q3 apply the idea in new contexts: q2's 「初めて触るリポジトリで、READMEの誤字」 sets two cues against each other, and q3 uses a new plan item. Two items are weaker. q4 reuses the s4-interview hint scenario. e5 reuses it again, and its key 「すべて話し終えたら、完全な仕様をSPEC.mdに書いて。」 nearly copies line 3 of the s4-interview prompt.

Every misconception in the brief is a distractor whose feedback corrects it, with a reason, in 2 sentences or fewer: stronger adjectives (q0 a), Manual mode (q0 b, e4 d), /rewind (e4 b 「Bashで変えたものや外部への操作を戻せません」), the classifier (e4 c), trusting the plan (q3 c), always planning (q2 b), files already changed in plan mode (q3 d), and implementing in the same conversation (q4 c, e5 b).

s2-flow is a 5-node process diagram with Japanese labels that match the text (探索, 計画, プランモード, 実装して確かめる, コミット). Its caption states the takeaway, 「計画を読み、直してから承認して実装に進む」, and its alt text describes the loop back to planning. The lesson has no decorative images.

practice-steps is an authentic hands-on task in a throwaway folder (「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」), and every step has an expect. pr-rewrite and pr-plan give a hint, then a troubleshoot. practice-checklist and practice-model come after the steps, and practice-spec repeats the pattern for o3. The hint ladder has 2 levels, not 3. ps-ask's expect leaves out 「当たり前の質問はしない」, which c2-depth checks, and no step leads to c2-session.

summary-points has 5 takeaways and comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question (「4つの観点のうち、どれが抜けていたでしょうか」) and names 第4回 as the next step. summary-cards has 7 cards that match the body, for example card-good-spec 「関わるファイルとつなぎ目（関数名など）を書く…」. summary-ask offers 3 tutor prompts.

The three overclaims in audit-cc-03-plan-first.json are fixed in the current text. s2-version now states only 「autoモードからShift + Tabを押すと、Manual→acceptEdits→プランモードの順に変わります」, and s2-enter-lead and card-enter now say 「主な」 3 ways, with the version pinned (「2026年10月、v2.1.304時点」). The other claims match facts-cc-03-plan-first.md (Alt + V, Ctrl+G, 「No, keep planning」, the three spec conditions). One doubt remains: s3-tip states a correlational RCT finding as a reason (learning-33: 「Patterns linked to high scores」).

The whole lesson is in です・ます. The tone is warm and invites the learner (「書いてから見比べましょう」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」), there are no banned phrases, and terms are consistent with the glossary. Katakana terms carry English on first use (ステータスバー（status bar）, エディタ（editor））. A few sentences read slightly stiff, for example ex-explore 「知った現状が、計画を読む物差しになります」.

The lesson declares only jp and is complete in jp; English is deferred by design, as the brief says. s2-flow's labels are Japanese, and its alt text describes the structure and the loop. No text is baked into images, and there are no vague 「こちら」 links.

niceToHave: e5 (check-quiz): move the exam item off the 家計簿 scenario that s4-interview and q4 already use, so it becomes a transfer item for o3. Replace the quoted draft in the prompt with 「社内の会議室予約アプリに、予約の取り消し機能を足したい。AskUserQuestionツールで私に詳しくインタビューして。当たり前の質問はせず、難しい部分を掘り下げて。」 and keep the options as they are.

q4 or e5: to test more of the o3 create skill than the SPEC.md write-out, make one of the two items turn on another element, such as the three spec conditions in s4-good-spec. For example, ask which sentence to add to a draft that already writes to SPEC.md. The key would be 「仕様には、関わるファイル、範囲外のこと、最後に全体を確かめる手順を入れて。」
s3-check (q3): gloss package.json for beginners. Split the prompt into two sentences: 「別の作業の計画に、頼んでいない手順が入っていました。「新しいライブラリをpackage.json（使うライブラリの一覧）に追加する」という手順です。どうしますか？」
practice-spec-steps (ps-ask): make expect match c2-depth: 「AskUserQuestion、聞いてほしい話題3つ以上、「当たり前の質問はしない」の一文が入ります。」
practice-spec-checklist (c2-session): no step leads to this criterion. Either add to ps-spec's troubleshoot 「実装は、新しいセッションでSPEC.mdを読ませてから頼みます。」 or drop c2-session.
practice-steps: to reach a 3-level hint ladder, give pr-rewrite a fill-in template as a faded example before the model answer. Mind the prose budget: measure.mjs shows 2295 of 2400.

factual doubt: s3-tip presents the RCT's high-score patterns as a reason, but learning-33 reports them as 「Patterns linked to high scores」, which is correlational. A safer wording: 「説明を求めながら使った人は、任せきりの人より理解度テストの点が高い傾向でした。」
s4-flow: add "cc-commands" to cite, since the block names `/clear`, which is documented on the Commands page.
summary: This is a full review because the earlier verification rounds were recorded against uncommitted .artifacts snapshots; the lesson text has not changed since the last round (lessonHash sha256:50da68311b84aa11). Its biggest strength is the close fit between the brief's misconceptions and distractor feedback, along with a worked example that is reused in a hands-on practice task; the three fact-audit overclaims are fixed. The most useful improvement is moving e5 to a new scenario and having it test more of the o3 create skill than the SPEC.md write-out that q4 already tests.
